form.why: The earlier hand-built version makes the 40 x 20 superellipsoid (half 0.35, 0.31, 0.29; exponent 0.85 across, 0.95 above the middle, 0.70 below). The current head restores it and shifts it 0.045 toward the back, so the centre's Z is -0.045.

An eye is printed on the face, a decal, not a lens (markings are decals, a design call of this kit). The earlier hand-built version makes a lens oval (half 0.058, 0.088, 0.014) and seats it on the head from the front; the current eye moves it to x 0.12, y 0.655 and squashes its height by 0.15 / 0.176, so the half height is 0.075. The decal keeps that oval, cast onto the head from the front at the same spot, round the rim in 64 segments and across it in 16 rings (the lens had 32 segments; the grid is finer because the decal now stands off the head by the contact length (one arcminute at 1.3 m, 0.38 mm), and a coarser face dips under the head's facets: the build refuses it), so its faces are small against the head's curve.
The earlier hand-built version seats the right eye at -x with the same build as the left.

This form sets the half width and half depth tables (HW, HD) and makes the bottom cap a super ellipse of power 5; the top cap stays round, 0.045 each. The axis runs from y 0.435 to 0.105, the span of the earlier blob. The end rows hold the values at 0.15 and 0.39. The vertex angles are the ring form's own, not taken from earlier builds. It has 22 rings, not the 20 of the earlier blob: with 20 the ring step at y 0.387, next to the top cap's start at 0.39, turned 25 to 26 degrees and drew a crease the reference does not have.

The earlier hand-built version makes the arm (profile, round tip and mitten base, inner side squared at the shoulder, thumb bump, 3 smoothing passes below y 0.27). The current arm remaps each ring: half side a * fx(z), centre 0.185 + a * fx(z), half depth b * gy(z), depth centre -0.025 + (cy + 0.025) * gy(z). It adds 0.03 depth and pushes the hand out (the push deform). The bottom pole sits where the rings close, not at the earlier version's pb 0.06 to the side: an off-centre pole folds its fan's faces back over each other, a mark seen from below. The thumb is wider along the arm than the earlier version's (u_width 0.125, not 0.10), so its fold stays under 20 degrees and the outline draws no dash across it. The thumb height and lift are fitted to the replayed thumb at that width: height 0.03577 and lift 0.01023 (the earlier version used 0.036 and 0.012 before the remap stretched the arm by about 1.15 across and 1.12 deep); the fit leaves 4.80 mm at most and 2.39 mm rms over the 474 thumb vertices.
The earlier hand-built version makes the right arm with s = -1: the left arm with x negated.

The earlier hand-built version: a capsule from y 0.27 to 0.052, radius 0.06, depth flattened to 0.94, round caps 0.06. The current thigh scales x by 1.25 about the leg's x, so the half side is 0.075 and the half depth is 0.06 * 0.94.
The earlier hand-built version makes the right thigh with x = -0.105: the left thigh with x negated.

The earlier hand-built version, a meta shape: two balls (r 0.058 at y 0.107, r 0.056 at y 0.085) and an ellipsoid (half 0.072, 0.044, 0.084 at y 0.046). The current shin scales x by 1.25, so each element's half x grows by 1.25, and flattens the heel: the back side from 0.03 to 0.05.
The earlier hand-built version makes the right shin and foot at x = -0.105: the left piece with x negated.

chibi.done: A 1.0-unit-tall chibi whose head spans 0.42 to 1.0 of its height. Its 10 closed parts overlap at the joints instead of welding, so a runtime outline draws the creases. Every clip of the earlier hand-built rig plays on it unchanged. At the page camera it matches that version within the acceptance of the comparison in `bars/03-chibi/COMPARE.md`.
